adjudication_path: Maharashtra Stamp Act 1958 s.31/s.32 (adjudication) & s.34 (admission on payment of duty + penalty); s.53A revision

source.ref: Maharashtra Stamp Act, 1958, s.34 proviso & s.31(4) proviso
source.quoted_text: MSA s.34 (verbatim, India Code text): '... (ii) a penalty at the rate of 2 per cent. of the deficient portion of the stamp duty for every month or part thereof, from the date of execution of such instrument: Provided that, in no case, the amount of the penalty shall exceed [four times] the deficient portion of the stamp duty.' The identical 2%/month, max four-times cap appears in the s.31(4) adjudication proviso. RESOLVES the earlier 200%-vs-400% source conflict: the current statutory cap is FOUR TIMES (400%), verified from the primary Act text.

notes_for_reviewer: CONFIDENCE: HIGH (primary Act text; resolved the source conflict). 2% per month of the deficient duty, from the date of execution, capped at 4× the deficiency. Requires penalty_months input (whole months elapsed) — the engine takes it as an argument, not a clock read, for determinism. Discretionary reductions are separate (s.34 mandatory-rate vs Collector adjudication).
